term: epistemic entitlement, withholding and unsettled foundation
definition: Verdict distinguishes entitled, explicitly withheld, and unsettled. StrongSkeptic assigns withholding to every topic, including habit. This critic reconstruction is stronger than Hume denying a reasoning-based origin or reporting an unsatisfied philosophical request. Neither unsettled nor withheld asserts the falsity of the predicted event.
